title: Circlet of Blasting

sources.title: Scorching Ray
markers: | description = Hurl '''3''' rays of fire. Each ray deals {{DamageText|2d6|Fire}} damage.

summary: Use an Action once per Long Rest to cast Scorching Ray. Make three separate ranged spell attacks at one or more targets within 60 ft. Each ray deals 2d6 Fire.

fields.Effect: Use an Action once per Long Rest to cast Scorching Ray. Make three separate ranged spell attacks at one or more targets within 60 ft. Each ray deals 2d6 Fire.
fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
